retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy portrait of a musician positioned off-center, paired with bold, left-aligned geometric typography and horizontal rule accents.
triggerTerms: high contrast portrait with gold text
grainy film portrait with geometric sans-serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, high-contrast portrait of a male figure with dark curly hair and a mustache, wearing a dark coat and patterned scarf, set against a textured dark background. The composition is anchored by a large block of left-aligned, gold-colored geometric sans-serif text featuring horizontal bars.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center against a dark, textured void
Bold gold typography balanced against the subject's dark silhouette
Horizontal rules integrated into the text block to create structural rhythm
High-contrast lighting emphasizing facial features and white shirt
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain texture across the entire image
Deep navy or charcoal background with high-contrast highlights
Gold or ochre color for all graphic and typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-long shot, positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, leaning slightly left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white shirt collar provide the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright face, move down the diagonal of the body, then jump to the bold text block on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space on the left side serves as the canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white shirt and dark coat.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars placed between lines of text to act as separators

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in negative space beside subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying line breaks and horizontal rule accents.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s/80s aesthetic and wide proportions.
Provides the necessary geometric purity and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy film portrait of a man with 80s styling, positioned on the right, against a dark navy textured background with ample negative space on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, gold-colored geometric sans-serif text in all-caps, left-aligned in the negative space, incorporating thin horizontal bars between specific lines.

verificationChecks: Is the text left-aligned in the negative space?
Is the grain texture consistent across the image?
Are the horizontal rules present between text lines?
Is the color palette limited to navy, white, and gold?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast lighting on the face
Ensure text is solid gold without gradients
Verify the subject is off-center to the right
Confirm the presence of horizontal rule accents
Check for heavy film grain texture
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast grainy portrait + off-center subject + left-aligned geometric gold typography + horizontal rule accents.
